messages:
pagerduty-bot: :rotating_light: High 5xx spike on /v1/generate (hosted-us-west) — errors up 12x over baseline, p50 latency up 2.3x. Auto-alert triggered. link: https://ops.redwood/test/alerts/2945678901

incidents-bot: Incident opened: INCIDENT-2026-042/edge-retry-fanout. Severity: sev2. Paging sre-oncall. Playbook: smart-routing fallbacks -> fanout.

sre-oncall: On it. grabbing logs and routing tables. tagging @emma and @raj for routing policy changes.

emma: I see a config rollout ~10:12 UTC that changed smart-routing policy weight rules for model variants in us-west -> fallthrough to eu-west. rollout id: rollout-2026-04-12-1012.

raj: That rollout mapped model 'm-redwood-alpha' -> fallback chain to 'm-redwood-beta' and then to 'm-redwood-gpu-eu' when capacity tight. Looks like the policy doesn't short-circuit when the downstream returns 429, it triggers fallback which re-enters routing and creates another request to the fallback host.

mike: Clients are aggressively retrying (observed exponential backoff disabled in some SDK versions). Combined with server-side failover we are getting fanout: each original request => 3 attempts across regions. That explains traffic amplification.

incidents-bot: Pager duty: sre-oncall acknowledged at 10:16.

emma: Mitigation plan: 1) Disable new smart-routing rollout (control-plane toggle). 2) Apply short-term edge retry throttling (global per-client rate limit). 3) Patch router to not cascade fallback into new routing loop.

raj: I'm going to flip the rollout off now. curl to control plane:
```bash
curl -X POST https://control.redwood.internal/api/v1/rollouts/rollout-2026-04-12-1012/disable \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $ADMIN_TOKEN"
```

raj: done. rollback triggered. metrics should show improvement in ~30s for routing lookups.

sre-oncall: Good. Applying edge retry cap: setting max_attempts=2 and per-client backoff jitter. Pushing config to api-gateway.

infra-eng: Pushing rate limit rule to edge: 
```yaml
- name: global-client-max-rps
  match: "client_id:*"
  limit: 50rps
  burst: 100
  scope: client_id
```
applied to all ingress proxies 10:21 UTC

mike: We're seeing immediate drop in error rate on host us-west-1 proxy. 5xx down from 12x to ~3x. latency p50 still elevated though.

cs-lead: Heads up — we have 2 enterprise customers reporting elevated latency and 1 that hit 429s. Reached out to account teams; will provide status update once we have impact window.

emma: Root cause summary so far: rollout introduced a fallback policy that chained across variants+regions without accounting for client retry semantics or 429 semantics. Combined with a subset of SDKs using aggressive client retries (no jitter, low backoff) led to N->M fanout (thundering herd-ish).

raj: Short-term patch: router will now mark fallbacks triggered by 429/503 as terminal for that request ID and return upstream a 503-with-retry-after header instead of re-injecting into routing. Preparing hotfix.

incidents-bot: Escalation: recommending SE oncall loop-in for customers with sustained errors.

mike: Hotfix deployed to router staging, rolling to prod now (canary 10:28). Patch changes:
```diff
- if (downstream == unhealthy) { fallback(); }
+ if (downstream == unhealthy && downstream_code not in [429, 503]) { fallback(); }
+ else { return 503 + Retry-After }
```

sre-oncall: Canary looks healthy. Metrics show error amplification stopped for canary pool. Rolling to remainder.

emma: After full rollout of the hotfix, 5xx amplification back to baseline in 8 minutes. p50 latency reduced ~28%. Confirming with graphs.

cs-lead: Notifying affected customers: staged message drafted and being sent. advising clients to upgrade SDK patch (client-side backoff) but note server-side mitigation in place.

raj: Post-mortem action items (short list):
- revert unsafe rollout gating checks -> done
- add unit/integration tests for fallback not causing re-route loops
- add canary rule requiring failure-mode simulation with client retries
- contact top 5 customers with incident summary and remediation steps
- change default SDK retry to include jitter and exponential backoff

mike: Paging handoff: I'm taking incident commander for next 30m to finalize comms and follow-ups. paging @emma for routing follow-up, @raj for postmortem.

incidents-bot: Incident status: under mitigated. severity downgraded to sev3 at 10:41.

cs-lead: Sent initial incident notice to impacted customers at 10:45 UTC. One customer asked for extended logs; will route to infra-eng secure-log link.

emma: Adding config lint rule to catch policies that create cross-region fallthrough without a max-fanout limit.

sre-oncall: Thanks team — will file full postmortem draft and assign owners. Closing incident channel in 24h. :white_check_mark:
